claims.text: Single-phase ZrB2 can be prepared by spark plasma sintering at 1800 °C.
The proposed SPS preparation can be performed under vacuum or an inert atmosphere.
Optimized SPS at 1800 °C will produce a nanoscale-uniform distribution of metal elements in the ZrB2 ceramic.
A high-entropy effect will enhance diffusion in the proposed ceramic.
A high-entropy effect will enhance sintering in the proposed ceramic.
The uniform distribution of metal elements will increase the density of the ZrB2 ceramic.
The uniform distribution of metal elements will reduce the porosity of the ZrB2 ceramic.
The uniform distribution of metal elements will enhance the mechanical properties of the ZrB2 ceramic.
SPS-prepared ZrB2 will have higher density than conventionally prepared ZrB2.
SPS-prepared ZrB2 will have lower porosity than conventionally prepared ZrB2.
SPS-prepared ZrB2 will have better mechanical properties than conventionally prepared ZrB2.

contradictions.description: The initial material and intervention specify only ZrB2 powder and SPS, with no addition of multiple metal species, yet the mediator invokes a distribution of 'metal elements' and the mechanism invokes a high-entropy effect. A processing-only intervention on nominally single-component ZrB2 does not establish the multicomponent chemistry required by that mechanism.
